annual.note: Fiscal year ended July 3, 2026 (53 weeks), audited 10-K filed 2026-08-17. Statements are filed in whole USD millions (no decimals). No debt: the $2.0B term loan (issued at the Feb 2025 spin-off from Western Digital) was settled in full on March 4, 2026 and the $1.5B revolver is undrawn. No options, no warrants, no convertibles; the only employee claims are RSUs/PSUs (6.6M; PSU max-case adds ~2.2M more shares) and ESPP purchase rights ($71M unamortized). Share count: filed balance sheet is rounded to 146 million; the exact 146,419,001 is the Aug 7, 2026 cover figure (carried only because the period-end exact count is not disclosed); company repurchased ~3M shares ($4.5B) in FY26 and announced a $14.0B program on Aug 5, 2026, so shares may be lower after Aug 7. Spin-off items: Western Digital has almost exited its stake (80.1% distributed Feb 21, 2025; 14.6% disposed June 9, 2025 and 5.8M shares on Feb 18, 2026 via debt-for-equity exchanges; WDC retained 1,691,884 shares (about 1.2%) after Feb 18, 2026 and expects to monetize the rest by end of 2026 (these are already inside the outstanding share count, so no extra dilution); the $128M tax indemnification liability is recorded; Tax Matters Agreement restricts share issuances/business combinations. Items NOT counted in the numeric fields: Flash Ventures notes receivable and equity investments $679M (operating JV supply arrangement; balance sheet shows $678M), 20% SDSS equity-method stake $167M, Unis Venture 48% (not material), Flash Ventures lease guarantees $923M (contingent), unrecognized tax benefits $323M plus $16M interest/penalties, income tax payable current $1,286M, customer refund liabilities (security deposits) $1,500M and contract liabilities $849M current + $393M non-current (customer prepayments under long-term agreements), long-term supplier commitments $5,892M. After year end: two new long-term customer agreements totaling $31.3B.
